entities.summary: Jean-Philippe Fleurian is a former tennis player from France, who turned professional in 1985. In his career, he won one doubles title. The right-hander reached his highest ranking on the ATP Tour on 30 April 1990, when he became world No. 37. He now is retired and has two daughters.
